name: CBFunnelPro
author: Crispin Thomas

sections.description:
Turn Your WordPress Site Into a Sales-Generating Machine with CBFunnelPro, the go-to solution for WordPress site owners looking to maximize their ClickBank affiliate earnings. With its robust automation and intuitive features, this plugin simplifies your marketing workflow and delivers better results, faster.

  • Automate Your Campaigns: Automatically insert ClickBank banners into posts and pages with your unique affiliate ID.

  • Track and Optimize: Built-in analytics provide insights into clicks, impressions, and conversions to help you refine your strategy.

  • Boost Conversions: Engage your audience through automated email follow-ups designed to turn subscribers into buyers.

  • Effortless Setup: CBFunnelPro is user-friendly and easy to configure, so you can get started in just a few clicks.

Whether you’re a seasoned marketer or just starting your affiliate journey, CBFunnelPro empowers you to take control of your ClickBank campaigns and grow your revenue on autopilot.

API Documentation

CBFunnelPro utilizes several API endpoints to enhance functionality and ensure up to date information:

  • /getcategories.php and /getsubcat.php – Populates the Setting Page with the latest data.
  • /getmybanner2.js – Fetches text and image banners dynamically.
  • /sendmsg.php – Handles registration data for new users.
  • /updateuser.php – Updates existing user settings.
  • /reportscripts.js – Retrieves analytics for impressions, clicks, and sales.
  • /getimages.php – Fetches product images and metadata.
  • /setparameters.php – Configures parameters related to the current user session.

Additional Features

  • Email Follow-Ups:
    To reduce the complexity of managing email funnels, CBFunnelPro integrates with a hosted solution at SmartEZSolutionz. This ensures seamless delivery of:

    • Pre-sell pages.
    • Opt-in forms for user registration.
    • Redirects to the product sales page.

Affiliate commissions are credited directly to your ClickBank ID throughout the process.

  • Monetization:
    A portion of opt-ins is marketed to by our service to maintain database hosting, email systems, and infrastructure, ensuring cost efficiency for all users.

For even more details and documentation, visit cbfunnelpro.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly from WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Settings → CBFunnelPro to configure your account and start promoting ClickBank products.

Learn more here https://cbfunnelpro.com/tutorials/
sections.faq:
**What is CBFunnelPro?**

CBFunnelPro is a WordPress plugin designed to automate ClickBank affiliate marketing, enabling you to easily create sales funnels and track campaign performance.

**Do I need a ClickBank account to use this plugin?**

Yes, you need to sign up for a free affiliate account on ClickBank.

**Is coding experience required to use this plugin?**

Not at all! CBFunnelPro is designed with simplicity in mind. Install, configure, and let the plugin handle the heavy lifting.

**How are analytics and email follow-ups handled?**

Analytics are displayed within your WordPress dashboard. Email funnels are securely managed on external servers, requiring no additional setup for email providers.

**How do I get paid?**

All payments are handled directly by Clickbank bi-weekly, and you can be paid via Direct Deposit, Paypal, Wire-Transfer and other methods. See article here https://support.clickbank.com/hc/en-us/articles/220609947-How-do-I-get-paid
